ToD_A04_M14_VO_001.source_old: I don't wanna go to the catacombs, it’s scary…
ToD_A04_M14_VO_001.source_new: I don't wanna go to the catacombs, it’s scary…

ToD_A04_M14_VO_002.source_old: You will be safe there child, don't be afraid, the light will protect you, and  your mother and siblings will have need of you in the halls below. Your duty is to them. Now go.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_002.source_new: You will be safe there child, don't be afraid, the light will protect you, and  your mother and siblings will have need of you in the halls below. Your duty is to them. Now go.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_003.source_old: Sir Uther, we have locked the gates and prepared the ballistas.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_003.source_new: Sir Uther, we have locked the gates and prepared the ballistas.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_004.source_old: Good, order archers to mount the defense on the parapets, Lordaeron will not fall today!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_004.source_new: Good, order archers to mount the defense on the parapets, Lordaeron will not fall today!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_005.source_old: Warchief, the strike force awaits your command.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_005.source_new: Warchief, the strike force awaits your command.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_006.source_old: Good. We need to capture Fenris island and build a base near the goldmine. After we accomplish that, our assault on the capital can finally begin.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_006.source_new: Good. We need to capture Fenris island and build a base near the goldmine. After we accomplish that, our assault on the capital can finally begin.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_007.source_old: Faster you lazy maggot! The siege of the capital begins at dawn… if you are not ready by then, the Warchief will have your hides!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_007.source_new: Faster you lazy maggot! The siege of the capital begins at dawn… if you are not ready by then, the Warchief will have your hides!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_008.source_old: Dragonmaw and Blacktooth grin sails… the carriers of my vengeance return at last.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_008.source_new: Dragonmaw and Blacktooth grin sails… the carriers of my vengeance return at last.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_010.source_old: Greetings Warchief. We lost many good warriors, but your will is fulfilled.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_010.source_new: Greetings Warchief. We lost many good warriors, but your will is fulfilled.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_011.source_old: Good… my misguided mercy has now been rectified. This will be a reminder to anyone who would dare oppose my rule.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_011.source_new: Good… my misguided mercy has now been rectified. This will be a reminder to anyone who would dare oppose my rule.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_012.source_old: Warchief, we have captured some survivors from the Twilight’s hammer and the Stormreaver clans. They’re begging for your forgiveness.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_012.source_new: Warchief, we have captured some survivors from the Twilight’s hammer and the Stormreaver clans. They’re begging for your forgiveness.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_013.source_old: Yes, Warchief. They surrendered after we destroyed their fleet and slaughtered their leaders.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_013.source_new: Yes, Warchief. They surrendered after we destroyed their fleet and slaughtered their leaders.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_014.source_old: Gul’dan’s betrayal has cost so much… In light of this fact we thought it wisest to deliver them to your court, instead of slaughtering them outright.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_014.source_new: Gul’dan’s betrayal has cost so much… In light of this fact we thought it's wisest to deliver them to your court, instead of slaughtering them outright.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_015.source_old: They are all untrustworthy traitors… but you are right, Rend. The strength of our armies have decreased dramatically, though it pains me greatly to admit it. One way or the other, the future of the Horde will be decided today. Put those ogres in the vanguard… their debt to us will be repaid in blood. As for the rest of them - the Death Knights will watch over them until I decide their fate.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_015.source_new: They are all untrustworthy traitors… but you are right, Rend. The strength of our armies have decreased dramatically, though it pains me greatly to admit it. One way or the other, the future of the Horde will be decided today. Put those ogres in the vanguard… their debt to us will be repaid in blood. As for the rest of them - the Death Knights will watch over them until I decide their fate.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_016.source_old: What is our next objective, Warchief?
ToD_A04_M14_VO_016.source_new: What is our next objective, Warchief?

ToD_A04_M14_VO_017.source_old: Teron Gorefiend struggles with the siege of Dalaran to the south.  I want you to throw all the forces that you have against that city. Rend and Maim will go with you.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_017.source_new: Teron Gorefiend struggles with the siege of Dalaran to the south.  I want you to throw all the forces that you have against that city. Rend and Maim will go with you.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_018.source_old: Wouldn't we be more useful against the capital city?
ToD_A04_M14_VO_018.source_new: Wouldn't we be more useful against the capital city?

ToD_A04_M14_VO_019.source_old: No, Rend. The Violet Citadel of Dalaran serves as sanctum and heaven to the mages of the Kirin Tor. Once Lordaeron has fallen, Dalaran will be the last and the most dangerous barrier between the Horde and the subjugation of humanity.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_019.source_new: No, Rend. The Violet Citadel of Dalaran serves as sanctum and heaven to the mages of the Kirin Tor. Once Lordaeron has fallen, Dalaran will be the last and the most dangerous barrier between the Horde and the subjugation of humanity.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_020.source_old: It is good that we have saved our greatest weapon for just this moment - Dragons! A flock of them just joined in from the hatcheries of the Dragonmaw!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_020.source_new: It is good that we have saved our greatest weapon for just this moment - Dragons! A flock of them just joined in from the hatcheries of the Dragonmaw!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_021.source_old: Yes! Today the last bastions of humanity will burn in dragon fire. Go now!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_021.source_new: Yes! Today the last bastions of humanity will burn in dragon fire. Go now!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_022.source_old: You shall not pass, twisted undead creature!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_022.source_new: You shall not pass, twisted undead creature!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_023.source_old: Your petty magick can’t stop us, mage.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_023.source_new: Your petty magick can’t stop us, mage.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_024.source_old:
I can see the Cross island - the key point of the Dalarans' defense.
Teron Gorefiend has started the attack, but his forces are progressing slowly.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_024.source_new: I can see the Cross island - the key point of the Dalarans' defense. Teron Gorefiend has started the attack, but his forces are progressing slowly.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_025.source_old: What is the best tactic we can use to aid him?
ToD_A04_M14_VO_025.source_new: What is the best tactic we can use to aid him?

ToD_A04_M14_VO_026.source_old: There are three arcane observatories that are shielding the hearth of the island - Violet citadel. If we destroy them, the kirin tor defenders will lose their magical shielding.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_026.source_new: There are three arcane observatories that are shielding the hearth of the island - Violet citadel. If we destroy them, the kirin tor defenders will lose their magical shielding.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_027.source_old: And after that we can sack the citadel itself!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_027.source_new: And after that we can sack the citadel itself!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_028.source_old: The citadel is protected by the spell conjured by the archmage. First, we need to kill him.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_028.source_new: The citadel is protected by the spell conjured by the archmage. First, we need to kill him.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_029.source_old: I will have great pleasure to slice him into pieces!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_029.source_new: I will have great pleasure to slice him into pieces!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_030.source_old: We need to use our forces wisely. Ships and Towers are protecting the island.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_030.source_new: We need to use our forces wisely. Ships and Towers are protecting the island.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_031.source_old: Dragons will burn the defenses and prepare the site for our ground troops' arrival.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_031.source_new: Dragons will burn the defenses and prepare the site for our ground troops' arrival.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_032.source_old: Thank you for freeing me from this prison, strangers, the Kirin Tor doesn't respect ambitious wizards like me.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_032.source_new: Thank you for freeing me from this prison, strangers, the Kirin Tor doesn't respect ambitious wizards like me.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_033.source_old: They thought my experiments were too bold, I was punished for it, regardless, I'm done with this place, to hell with all of you!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_033.source_new: They thought my experiments were too bold, I was punished for it, regardless, I'm done with this place, to hell with all of you!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_036.source_old: I will report to the warchief about our success here.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_036.source_new: I will report to the warchief about our success here.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_037.source_old: Good. The Dragonmaw and Blacktooth grin forces arrived at perfect timing. We will go south and prepare for the siege of the city.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_037.source_new: Good. The Dragonmaw and Blacktooth grin forces arrived at perfect timing. We will go south and prepare for the siege of the city.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_038.source_old: Warchief, The camp and supplies are ready for the attack on the Capital!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_038.source_new: Warchief, The camp and supplies are ready for the attack on the Capital!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_039.source_old: Good, We shall start the attack now!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_039.source_new: Good, We shall start the attack now!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_040.source_old: Warchief! The cross island has fallen under the might of the Horde!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_040.source_new: Warchief! The cross island has fallen under the might of the Horde!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_042.source_old: Utok! You will stay here with me. I want you to scribe the glorious moment when the walls of Lordaeron fall to our furious armies! We end this… today! Rise up Sons of the Horde! Blood and glory awaits us!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_042.source_new: Utok! You will stay here with me. I want you to scribe the glorious moment when the walls of Lordaeron fall to our furious armies! We end this… today! Rise up Sons of the Horde! Blood and glory awaits us!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_043.source_old: We need to end the remnants of Lordaeron’s pathetic fleet.  Destroy the harbour and use it as a location for our siege weapons and ground troops to attack the city.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_043.source_new: We need to end the remnants of Lordaeron’s pathetic fleet.  Destroy the harbour and use it as a location for our siege weapons and ground troops to attack the city.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_044.source_old: There should be several ways to launch assaults against the city. Let’s use zeppelins to scout the shoreline.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_044.source_new: There should be several ways to launch assaults against the city. Let’s use zeppelins to scout the shoreline.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_045.source_old: Today, I will finally prove to the Warchief who's the better Orc…Scratcher!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_045.source_new: Today, I will finally prove to the Warchief who's the better Orc…Scratcher!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_046.source_old: “scoffs” don’t push it, ‘Captain Tharbek’, the Warchief does not tolerate soldiers who disobey their superiors, now fall to command!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_046.source_new: Don’t push it, ‘Captain Tharbek’, the Warchief does not tolerate soldiers who disobey their superiors, now fall to command!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_049.source_old: Warchief, the walls are heavily fortified and we are losing many warriors to elven archers and ballistas.
ToD_A04_M14_VO_049.source_new: Warchief, the walls are heavily fortified and we are losing many warriors to elven archers and ballistas.

ToD_A04_M14_VO_050.source_old: We have come too far to be denied by arrows and wall defenses… Rise up my mighty Horde! Glory and riches awaits you beyond these walls! Shred them to pieces my warriors, and take what is rightfully yours!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_050.source_new: We have come too far to be denied by arrows and wall defenses… Rise up my mighty Horde! Glory and riches awaits you beyond these walls! Shred them to pieces my warriors, and take what is rightfully yours!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_052.source_old: I've met gnomes that are tougher than you!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_052.source_new: I've met gnomes that are tougher than you!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_053.source_old: Aw, is that the best you can do?!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_053.source_new: Aw, is that the best you can do?!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_057.source_old: We'll fight for Lordaeron! Get your swords!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_057.source_new: We'll fight for Lordaeron! Get your swords!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_058.source_old: You shall not take this city!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_058.source_new: You shall not take this city!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_059.source_old: Demon worshipping fanatics, be purged by the light!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_059.source_new: Demon worshipping fanatics, be purged by the light!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_060.source_old: Men! Defend the city at all costs!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_060.source_new: Men! Defend the city at all costs!

ToD_A04_M14_VO_061.source_old: The alabaster parapets of Lordaeron's capital loom before us in the distance. The proud, defiant armies of the Alliance stand resolute in their final, fleeting moments. All that remains is the shrill, clarion call to battle and the fulfillment of our destiny. The tides of darkness are now at hand!
ToD_A04_M14_VO_061.source_new: The alabaster parapets of Lordaeron's capital loom before us in the distance. The proud, defiant armies of the Alliance stand resolute in their final, fleeting moments. All that remains is the shrill, clarion call to battle and the fulfillment of our destiny. The tides of darkness are now at hand!

ToD_A04_M14_TXT_003.source_old: Fenris Isle stands between you and our ultimate price. Eliminate our enemies, seize the island and establish a strong foothold. Only then can we lay siege to the capital city itself.
ToD_A04_M14_TXT_003.source_new: Fenris Isle stands between you and our ultimate price. Eliminate our enemies, seize the island and establish a strong foothold. Only then can we lay siege to the capital city itself.
